sections.content: Normalization removes redundancy by splitting data into related tables: 1NF (atomic values), 2NF (no partial dependencies), 3NF (no transitive dependencies).
Example: instead of repeating customer name/address on every order, store customers once and reference by id. Denormalization trades purity for read speed.
Key points: normalize to avoid update anomalies, denormalize selectively for hot read paths, and learn the normal forms conceptually before deep theory.
